selection.excluded_note: Rows listed in exclusions are counted per year and not stored. Counties without an EPA row are not stored; the map labels them no_reported_value at read time, as for the current year. EPA AQS still reports Connecticut by its eight former counties, which match the 2020 county boundaries used for every earlier year.
